description: Krao's own aggregate analytics, computed by the rewards service from what Krao's services report to it. Counts only: no DIDs, nothing sent to third parties.

cohort.description: Accounts created in one week (Monday to Monday, Vietnam time). dN counts those active on day N after the day they were created (d1: day 1; d7: days 6-8; d30: days 28-32); absent until every account of the cohort is past the window.

week.description: The Monday the week starts on, YYYY-MM-DD (Vietnam time).
